queries.name: Single trace_id lookup
queries.ch: SELECT count() FROM k8s_logs WHERE trace_id = '299cb1bc60705f72a45c7d9f70a82156' AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000
queries.oo: SELECT count(*) FROM k8s_logs WHERE trace_id = '299cb1bc60705f72a45c7d9f70a82156'
queries.ch_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE trace_id = '299cb1bc60705f72a45c7d9f70a82156' AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
queries.oo_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE trace_id = '299cb1bc60705f72a45c7d9f70a82156' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Single span_id lookup
queries.ch: SELECT count() FROM k8s_logs WHERE span_id = '7a4e90080fd2a013' AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000
queries.oo: SELECT count(*) FROM k8s_logs WHERE span_id = '7a4e90080fd2a013'
queries.ch_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE span_id = '7a4e90080fd2a013' AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
queries.oo_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE span_id = '7a4e90080fd2a013' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Rare whole-token lookup (full request id in text)
queries.ch: SELECT count() FROM k8s_logs WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['474dbfe4c65a971176ae239869a6ba47']) AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000
queries.ch_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['474dbfe4c65a971176ae239869a6ba47']) AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
queries.oo_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE match_all('474dbfe4c65a971176ae239869a6ba47') ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Common token search
queries.ch: SELECT count() FROM k8s_logs WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['failed']) AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000
queries.oo: SELECT count(*) FROM k8s_logs WHERE match_all('failed')
queries.ch_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['failed']) AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
queries.oo_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE match_all('failed') ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

queries.oo: SELECT count(*) FROM k8s_logs WHERE kubernetes_container_name = 'api-gateway-container' AND trace_id = '299cb1bc60705f72a45c7d9f70a82156'
queries.ch_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE kubernetes_container_name = 'api-gateway-container' AND trace_id = '299cb1bc60705f72a45c7d9f70a82156' AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
queries.oo_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE kubernetes_container_name = 'api-gateway-container' AND trace_id = '299cb1bc60705f72a45c7d9f70a82156' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Filter + token (container + match_all / hasAnyTokens)
queries.ch: SELECT count() FROM k8s_logs WHERE kubernetes_container_name = 'api-gateway-container' AND hasAnyTokens(message, ['474dbfe4c65a971176ae239869a6ba47']) AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000
queries.oo: SELECT count(*) FROM k8s_logs WHERE kubernetes_container_name = 'api-gateway-container' AND match_all('474dbfe4c65a971176ae239869a6ba47')
queries.ch_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE kubernetes_container_name = 'api-gateway-container' AND hasAnyTokens(message, ['474dbfe4c65a971176ae239869a6ba47']) AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Double token (common AND rarer token)
queries.ch: SELECT count() FROM k8s_logs WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['failed']) AND hasAnyTokens(message, ['474dbfe4c65a971176ae239869a6ba47']) AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000
queries.oo: SELECT count(*) FROM k8s_logs WHERE match_all('failed') AND match_all('474dbfe4c65a971176ae239869a6ba47')
queries.ch_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['failed']) AND hasAnyTokens(message, ['474dbfe4c65a971176ae239869a6ba47']) AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
queries.oo_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE match_all('failed') AND match_all('474dbfe4c65a971176ae239869a6ba47') ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: High-cardinality equality (pod_name)
queries.ch: SELECT count() FROM k8s_logs WHERE kubernetes_pod_name = 'api-gateway-9a2c1e6f4-8923f' AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000
queries.oo: SELECT count(*) FROM k8s_logs WHERE kubernetes_pod_name = 'api-gateway-9a2c1e6f4-8923f'
queries.ch_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE kubernetes_pod_name = 'api-gateway-9a2c1e6f4-8923f' AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
queries.oo_rows: SELECT * FROM k8s_logs WHERE kubernetes_pod_name = 'api-gateway-9a2c1e6f4-8923f' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Histogram (events over time, 1h buckets)
queries.note: Full-range GROUP BY time bucket — the events-over-time bar chart every log viewer draws. Exercises each engine's aggregation/scan path, not its skip indexes. Each side uses its idiomatic histogram (CH toStartOfHour, OO histogram()).
queries.ch: SELECT toStartOfHour(toDateTime(intDiv(_timestamp, 1000000))) AS ts, count() FROM k8s_logs WHERE _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
queries.oo: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS ts, count(*) FROM k8s_logs GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

queries.name: Top-N namespaces by volume
queries.note: Full-column GROUP BY over a LowCardinality dimension, ordered by count — the 'top talkers' panel on every dashboard. Pure aggregation work over the whole range.
queries.ch: SELECT kubernetes_namespace_name, count() AS c FROM k8s_logs WHERE _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 GROUP BY kubernetes_namespace_name ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
queries.oo: SELECT kubernetes_namespace_name, count(*) AS c FROM k8s_logs GROUP BY kubernetes_namespace_name ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: Filtered histogram (token match over time)
queries.note: The most realistic analyst query: 'show me failed over time'. Combines the full-text index (match_all / hasAnyTokens) with a time-bucket GROUP BY, so both the index and the aggregation path are exercised together.
queries.ch: SELECT toStartOfHour(toDateTime(intDiv(_timestamp, 1000000))) AS ts, count() FROM k8s_logs WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['failed']) AND _timestamp BETWEEN 1780272000000000 AND 1811808000000000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
queries.oo: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS ts, count(*) FROM k8s_logs WHERE match_all('failed') GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
